correctionReview.note: Season membership and low-appearance candidates removed; large outstanding DOB, positions, all-team league starts checks remain.

manutd.notes: Sheringham 23, Solskjær 19, Yorke 15, Cole 15 league starts: four qualified forward rotation; explicit cap exception.

arsenal.notes: Sylvinho 23 vs Ashley Cole 15 starts; swap primary LB. Edu 2 PL starts correctly excluded.

liverpool.notes: Fowler 15 league starts added to Owen/Heskey; 4-4-2 forward cap exception.

leeds.notes: All qualification cohort reviewed, Bowyer league 38 starts Viduka 34; position of Kewell / Bowyer still open.

ipswich.notes: 11v11 competition-filtered 2000-01 appearances used; Chris Makin RB and Alun Armstrong ST restored.

chelsea.notes: Chelsea 2000-01 full squad reviewed; winger role ambiguous due narrow attacking structure, Zola role awaiting position distribution.

astonvilla.notes: Paul Merson all 38 PL starts was critical omission; Ginola wide midfielder added, PL start count pending.

newcastle.notes: Original Dabizas nine all-competitions starts not primary CB; Hughes and Goma candidate CB, Griffin RB, Domi LB, Cordone LW restored; all position-majorities provisional.
